notes.title: Beast Hour. №25. August 2023. Playtest
notes.content:
[b]Raiders & Beasts![/b]

The summer is ending... and we're gearing up for another round of public testing and have some exciting updates to share with you. Dive into what's coming next for Beast Hour – discover what we've added & changed to make our game even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/87fa8db0d2f7a13fd47605cab01c25bbd1536d50.jpg[/img]
[b]Winged horror[/b]

We've been [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250/view/3379415101024643316?l=english]teasing[/url] the new Beast for a while now, and the time has come to play this winged monster! The Vampire model will be updated and finalized in the future, but that does not change the fact that you will already be able to immerse yourself in all its unique abilities in the upcoming play test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/0df5c869614afbb143b10c2ed402e392745bfc73.jpg[/img]
[b]New features of the haunted city[/b]

The Beast Hour universe continues to grow, and we've revamped the map with this update. New structures and captivating details will strengthen the gloomy atmosphere of the haunted city and tell its stories.

The full set of escape mechanics like invisibility mist, lifts, walls that allow Raiders to roll under them, suspension bridges, ziplines and portals will create for a much more fun parkour chases 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/4394d2b5275e870ba0d524f74142a231047bda00.jpg[/img]
Even Udoku makes her jump in a cool new way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/774f0286cf178e99118685e32f855bf1ecbef7a3.gif[/img]

[b]What, where, when[/b]

You've already heard about the notifications system (if not click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250/view/3653013848987739675?l=english]here[/url]). Now every player will get timely updates about events that are happening on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/34ff203aca7d56cab80353cc2b10727d911a596d.jpg[/img]

[b]Custom lobbies[/b]

Thanks to our updated networking, you can now set up custom lobbies. Bring in your friends, or open your doors for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/09ccceb7c695c6bfdbd224b90f21329c7f78281c.jpg[/img]
[b]Customize everything![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/7dfd961639d0c201a0147f05f64c61a4bb28ba22.jpg[/img]

So what about the technical side of things? In this update we added:
[list]
[*]controller support via Steam functionality,
[*]keybinding,
[*]detailed sound settings,
[*]and now you can play Beast Hour in English, French, German, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish.
[/list]
…and of course we got rid of different bugs. )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/f29ac859090dfec750d44553725e8496c203ef53.jpg[/img]
[b]Conclusion[/b]

We're excited to see you in the next playtesting phase and explore the grim world of Beast Hour together! Keep an eye on our social media for the latest updates, and brace yourself for the ultimate showdown.

Make sure to check our regular livestreams on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch[/url] channels, since it's a great opportunity for us to talk with you!

Follow Beast Hour on [url=https://linktr.ee/BeastHour]social media[/url], wishlist on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563250/Beast_Hour/]Steam[/url] and support on [url=https://www.patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url] – it does help our small indie team to bring the game to the next level!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №23. Июнь 2023. Матч мейкинг
notes.content:
Raiders and Beasts!

Today, we will explain the reason behind having 8 players in the game session.

The game was initially planned for 10 players: 8 Raiders and 2 Beasts (we've already [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250/view/3684547928689627496]told[/url] about the first idea of the game). We've planned an unusual 'team vs team' mode, where the Beasts would compete with each other for the Raiders, and the latter could play both individually and in groups. In fact, this concept is similar to Dead by Daylight, but with more players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/778dcef3da2db5f97c0b3c3549fa8dec6cba235b.jpg[/img]

[b]Team vs Team[/b]

Then we decided to try a team variant of 5 Raiders vs 5 Beasts. We took inspiration from Nosgoth, a game with 8 players in one match (4 for each side), for this concept.

The experiment turned the game into a complete deathmatch: players began to run in groups, parkour took a back seat, and the large map became less meaningful for chases. Also, unlike Nosgoth, Beast Hour has no class divisions (like Tank, Support, and DD), which ultimately led us to abandon the 'team vs team' PvP approach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2227bef8b456108afe66a5818f01cf72b9a11df6.gif[/img]

Then the number of players has been reduced to 7: 5 Raiders and 2 Beasts (tests showed that having 1 monster is too boring). To diversify the gameplay, additional activity points have appeared on the already updated map: Arkana quests, escape mechanics, and altars for Beasts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/5cbd2a3cfaab75eaa9a12e7207fba5b6e970cf03.jpg[/img]

[b]Arkana Storm and equal number of players[/b]

The ratio of 5 to 2 was interesting, but not ideal. 2 Beasts could only chase 2 Raiders. Even then, we've decided that Beast Hour would be a game without allies, which meant that 2 more Raiders could fight each other. That left one player, who basically shouldn't be afraid of an attack. So the solution came by itself: we added one more Beast and each player had an opponent.

But a new problem arose: due to the transition to the mechanics of respawns with their cancellation in the game's second phase, the last two or three players were hard to find each other in the final phase of the game on a large map for 8 participants. And that's where the idea of battle royale - space limitations, and the idea of not only narrowing the zone, but also moving it around the map - came to the rescue. This immediately solved the problem with the last players in the match and added variety.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/93cc341aa534eb2491b0ea7e266e61908724506f.gif[/img]

So we've got a clear scheme for the game:
[list]
[*] there are 8 players in the match (5 Raiders and 3 Beasts),
[*] in the first phase everyone respawns, regardless of the character type,
[*] in the second phase, players can no longer respawn (only the Raiders have one try at the beginning),
[*] zone narrows and shifts, maximizing the drama of the finale.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/573b0569cd825b619e97c9f28527d603ae2d057a.jpg[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Thanks for reading till the end! From time to time we try to change the number of players per match, but the current tests show that right now 5 vs 3 is the best ratio. This may change. What do you think would be the right number of players for Beast Hour? Share your opinion in the comments!

Make sure to check our regular livestreams on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch [/url]channels, since it's a great opportunity for us to talk with you!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №22. May 2023. Characters customization
notes.content:
Raiders and Beasts!

Today we'd like to talk about characters' skins – the feature we started working on not so long ago.

That's quite a frequent question on our social media, if we're planning to add customization in the game. And the answer is always - yes!

All multiplayer games have skins, which devs regularly add into the game. That brings more variety and personality, because you can not only play as your favorite character, but also change his or her appearance as you like.

For quite a time our artists have been designing different skins, that would fit perfectly into the overall atmosphere of the game. This includes radical re-coloring of the standard look, as well as new appearance that completely transforms the character. From time to time we share such arts on our social media. However, we started to implement the customization system in the game itself just recently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/b5d8e48bec10a292d1832157f596541f4d7839bd.jpg[/img]
[i]Standard re-color[/i]

[b]Raiders[/b]

It wasn't hard to come up with skins for Raiders: since they are humans in suits, we just have divided their outfits on 3 customizable parts – head, arms and body. That allows players to mix and match them, creating unique looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ee3f6cd165e4f1689661e476575227d69f70df37.jpg[/img]
[i]Combination of different sets[/i]

[b]Beasts[/b]

But we've faced some obstacles with Beasts. As they are naked monsters we can't split customization into 3 parts as we did for Raiders. Otherwise they would have visible "seams". Still we needed 3 customization parts, so we decided to change the following:

1. [b]body type[/b] - the whole "naked" body and its coloring, what solves the problem of seams between the parts;

2. [b]suit[/b] - different variations in clothing and decorations below the head/neck;

3. [b]head[/b] - things for the head/neck, like extra "hats", "collars" etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/748e403865b2a52b6504c03cc1887f690434fb44.jpg[/img]
[i]Various combinations for Beasts[/i]

[b]First prototypes[/b]

We already have a fair number of sketches that could be put to work and added to the game. But for the sake of time saving and testing the whole system (and, if necessary, tweak the images at the idea stage), we first added a set of the simplest "stubs".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/b02f06be1fd1c88eddbf35720c830cb9b284bf50.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins prototypes[/i]

This is why most of the "skins" in the game now are very bright and colourful. It's no coincidence that we chose such a toxic palette - it makes it easier to find bugs and gives more insight into the system work.

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Thank you for reading till the end. Which concept do you like best? Share your opinion in the comments!

Make sure to check our regular livestreams at [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch [/url]channels, since it's a great opportunity for us to talk with you!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №20. March 2023. Gamedesign
notes.content:
Raiders & Beasts!

Today we'd like to take a look at the genre of asymmetric PvP games and share our experience of developing Beast Hour.

[b]All new – well forgotten old[/b]

This genre exists for a long time and a lot of games have been released. When Beast Hour development started, we tried to find as much information about the first asymmetric games as possible. Then Giants: Citizen Kabuto, released in 2000 by Planet Moon Studios, caught our eye. This game is quite unique, as there are three races involved in a single match: 5 Sea Ripers, 3 Meccaryn and 1 giant Kabuto.

Analyzing other games is necessary for understanding the genre and a great source of inspiration for development. That's why we tried to study everything that could be useful in any way, mostly such games as Dead by Daylight, Evolve, Last Year, Predator: Hunting Grounds, Deathgarden.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c9c21e0761484b1a1484e3f51e88598b2071f3b3.jpg[/img]

[b]Not a DbD-clone[/b]

Of course, the main idea of "ones run away - others catch them" for us was Dead by Daylight, released in 2016 by Behavior Studios. It was one of the first internal projects independently created and published by this studio. The game quickly gained an audience and now it's considered the most popular asymmetrical horror game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ca2bae15267851a03eab79d3506a43b9c8199b39.jpg[/img]
[i]If Entity took Zelus into Dead by Daylight world, who would win?[/i]

It gave us a lot of ideas as we realized that players really like such games. But we didn't want to make another "DbD-clone". So, to the formula "1 immortal player against the opposing team" we've also added parkour elements and vertical gameplay. Thus, the first version of Beast Hour appeared. The game was: out of ten human Raiders random two turn into Beasts and hunt the remaining eight, trying to turn them into their pack's monsters.

Admittedly, it's problematic to find a perfect balance in games of this genre. An immortal boss-player is much stronger than any team member one-on-one, but a well-cooperated group drastically changes the balance in its favor. Plus, we didn't really like the idea of Beasts, one can do nothing against.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/d35676b870d7ac8f7c962a481605e9da256e73fc.gif[/img]

[b]Main ideas[/b]

By trial and error approach, we came up with three main principles, on which Beast Hour development is based even today:

1. [b]No allies game. [/b]Playing in teams, players would run together and enter team fights, so the whole point of parkour chases was lost. We wanted to focus on the dynamics of the game, which was only possible without teammates.

2. [b]The option to fight back. [/b]Since now there are no allies, we gave the opportunity to freely choose the role and fight any player, whether it's Beast or Raider. By the way, the players who have previously tried Dead by Daylight, like this idea a lot. Survivors often say that they would like to have more opportunities to "mock" the killer.

3. [b]Several bosses. [/b]The game involves three "bosses" at once, competing with each other for prey. It helps not only reinforce the ideas above, but also to create more "Beast after Raider" chases. It makes situations impossible where Raiders start to unintentionally team up against one Beast. Also the fights between monsters give a Raider more chances to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/0412cda8b3d85108506095fc22cabef3c23211e8.gif[/img]

On the whole, these principles gave the project its most important feature: the unique game experience of each match. Players decide whether to help or run, fight or flee, rely on cunning + agility or combat skills. This is what makes Beast Hour the game you want to play again and again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ba935a330290311342c0ef83cb3c3f7ebbdc05d2.gif[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Thanks for reading this article. We wanted to share our experience with asymmetric PvP development and perhaps answer some questions about Beast Hour genre. Share your opinion in the comments!

Make sure to check our regular livestreams at [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch[/url] channels, since it's a great opportunity for us to talk with you!

notes.title: Beast Hour. № 17. December 2022. Summary of the year
notes.content:
Raiders & Beasts!

Another year of Beast Hour development is behind. In today's newsletter we'll recall some of the coolest and the most memorable things that have happened this year as well as share our future hero plans!

[b]News and streams[/b]

It was at the beginning of 2022 when we got an idea to regularly post news about Beast Hour in this format. We published the summary of 2021 and so it started – there was not a single month we missed and each time we shared something exciting about the game both on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563250/Beast_Hour/]Steam[/url] and via [url=https://mailganer.com/landing/55677/]emails[/url]. Not only do we not plan to stop doing so, but we want to make these newsletters even better and more informative. Share your suggestions for new formats and topics in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/6a6177524420a6a316412bdd52e8d46870de2af4.jpg[/img]

By the way, alongside the newsletters, at the beginning of 2022 we also started making Beast Hour Q&A-streams, so that you have a direct way of communicating with us. We are a very open team thus we've decided to give EVERYONE an opportunity to take part in those streams. The only thing you need to do is join our [url=http://discord.gg/5KFaakTP24]Discord[/url] server and its voice chat – and you're live with us! Come and participate in the upcoming Q&A-stream at the 13th of January 2023.

[previewyoutube=w4AmiEaAPf4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]January 2022[/b]

In the first month of the year we did a lot of cool stuff. The biggest accomplishment was the new UI which replaced an old and technical one. If you've been following Beast Hour long enough you probably remember that first game videos and gifs didn't have any UI at all. Not because we didn't have any, but because we didn't want to show an obviously unfinished aspect of the project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/e4fcad3b1f42c526d4b3e86e408a1da1f77292f6.jpg[/img]

On top of all of that, that was the month our fan wrote a Beast Hour [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TDM1R_ayvGM]rap song[/url] and we made a small clip out of it. You should check it out!

[b]February 2022[/b]

In February the Spider district got updated and became an even more frightening and atmospheric place. Since then we kept on adding new pathways, mechanics and secrets to uncover – definitely visit it when you play Beast Hour next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/dd0df7a87dc82eed59b92247ff2dea106ddc2b66.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/aedde350c7c027e9822fa382589ea23bd5d16918.jpg[/img]

[b]March 2022[/b]

You asked us a lot and we heard you: in March we started developing a new hero – Vampire! The character was on a very early stage and so we could only show the first concept art. But, as it turned out, it was enough as we received a lot of positive feedback – thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c05dbc29e575a4731c5b5358966dd487cc8f6146.jpg[/img]

[b]April 2022[/b]

During the whole development cycle Beast Hour supported only two languages: English and Russian. But we knew that wasn't enough – we wanted to be sure that players from all over the world would have a chance to play the game. At this point we started looking for fans who could help with localizations. The first language was Japanese (it was unexpected even for us!)

Now there are multiple translations in the work: Spanish, French, Chinese, German, Polish and Arabic. If you know Italian, Korean or Portuguese – we'd be happy to see you in our team! Just send us an email at info@beasthour.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/1416479004d702bb17dfa168179db111d02bdd4c.jpg[/img]

[b]May 2022[/b]

In May we decided to tell more about Ziplines – one of our escape mechanics. Using Ziplines Raiders can go down from high buildings to keep the distance from pursuing Beasts. During the year we also showed you:

- [b]Cracked walls[/b] to roll under and stop the chaser.
- [b]Ropes [/b]to go up on rooftops quickly.
- [b]Portals [/b]to teleport to a random spot on the map.
- [b]Bridges [/b]to move between high rooftops.
- [b]Vault objects[/b] to jump over and get a speed boost.

During the next Beast Hour test you'll be able to experience them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/67736a025d8531b1bd8d444e84988fb24d5bee89.gif[/img]

[b]June 2022[/b]

It was one of the most important months in Beast Hour history! At 19th of June we ran our first ever public testing with the fans. It's hard to describe the feeling – a mixture of excitement and anxiety that made it into the most memorable day of the year for our team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/66e749db9fbb08d30f04e7442d61481ecaa2e2ad.jpg[/img]

[b]July 2022[/b]

Nikitozzz drew the first Beast Hour fan comic! It's so great when your efforts inspire other people – for that alone it's worth developing games! In the following months Nikitozzz continued to make more artwork, some of which will soon be published in our social media channels – [url=http://linktr.ee/BeastHour]subscribe[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/97b7e0ebedd4ff1cff8e3f67b96d3c929af0ff2a.jpg[/img]

[b]August 2022[/b]

After a few tests in a row it was decided to focus on solving the main issues the game had, including match connection problems and balancing. But it didn't mean we stopped making more features – on the contrary! In August we announced a number of them, and the most important one became the action log. It allows you to see the exact number of experience you get from every activity as well as informing you of events and the like. We also implemented sound settings, bridges and parkour improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/34ff203aca7d56cab80353cc2b10727d911a596d.jpg[/img]

[b]September 2022[/b]

In September we continued – nicknames were added, freezes at the start of every match were fixed and general map enhancements were done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/179ed619a8ca225088b6b6e3ec0e522ec0f538a4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/6f38825a9ce0912e1795035b0da50d31d216b5d2.jpg[/img]

[b]October 2022[/b]

It's a fact that thanks to Halloween many call October the spookiest month! We decided to celebrate this day by showcasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250?emclan=103582791469900204&emgid=3379415101024643316]Vampire[/url] in all its glory! It turned out to be a great article which is useful to other developers, lore enthusiasts and hardcore gamers who wish to know everything about heroes to get an advantage on the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/5e1a91f16ccab8e85b42903e6373490a0da758c8.gif[/img]

[b]November 2022[/b]

This gloomy autumn month we dedicated to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563250?emclan=103582791469900204&emgid=3645130650404661274]the map of Beast Hour and its history[/url]. This was the first 100% lore newsletter. Read it if you want to get acquainted with the city and not to get lost in there next time playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/c5cabb6d79a0dd1698c02de45319f1efeb770ee0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2ed1b95fb8ec6adeb6d6fd3d3dca4f461fdb9299.jpg[/img]

[b]December 2022[/b]

And lastly, a few weeks ago during one of our internal playtests we played Beast Hour with the controller. After many matches we figured out the best layout for our team. What do you think of it and would you use it yourself?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/7dfd961639d0c201a0147f05f64c61a4bb28ba22.jpg[/img]

[b]QUIZ[/b]

Test your knowledge of Beast Hour 2022 by completing a special quiz! Share your results in the comments!

[url=https://forms.gle/tdvh5wTAKu6tDMYY8 ]https://forms.gle/tdvh5wTAKu6tDMYY8 [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/aabaefe3ed69dd024e11acfe465413121dab7877.jpg[/img]

[b]New Raider – Drake![/b]

The most attentive of our fans remember that a year ago, in the summary of 2021, we hinted a new character but during the following months never mentioned him again. That's about to change! In one of the next newsletters he will be the center of our attention. Stay tuned!

One of the earliest concept arts of Drake:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/d472e6fa6b400d0b59d16fef4780350d42e04bd7.jpg[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

Make sure to check our livestreams we regularly have at our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH8SHBl_9bXEuNOr2ddveMQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beasthourgame]Twitch[/url] channels. The next stream will take place on 13th of January 2023, and the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eGNvSjZs2Y]latest one[/url] you can find on YouTube.

Follow Beast Hour on [url=https://linktr.ee/BeastHour]social media[/url] and support on [url=https://www.patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url] – it does help our small indie team to bring the game to a next level!

If you want to discuss any form of cooperation with us, use this email: bizdev@beasthour.com

The New Year is just around the corner! We at Beast Hour development team wish you to stay strong and keep doing your best! And don't forget to have fun along the way! 

The Beast will come!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/ab8ef9508d5750a6676c418a76163315a179f0aa.jpg[/img]

[b]Servers[/b]
* Since 2022-07-15: improved server matchmaking, games are found faster.

[b]Map[/b]
* Minor map bug fixes and decoration improvements (check out the Industrial District =)

[b]Mechanics[/b]
* Since 2022-07-15: added Ropes that quickly raise Raider to the top of the wall. Beasts can destroy them.

[b]Udoku Hiro[/b]
* Since 2022-07-15: default size of Gas Throw clouds increased.
* Since 2022-07-15: Gas Throw Upgrade #1 Spraying increases cloud size more.
* Gas Throw direct hits deal increased damage depending on the amount of poison stacks on the enemy.

[b]UI[/b]
* The Howl UI-mark now tells Raider how much Hunt time is left.
* If Raider becomes invisible while being marked by Beast's Howl, the Howl UI-mark turns gray, showing that Raider isn't visible to the Beast at this moment.
* Beast Howl ability icon tells Beast how much Hunt time is left.

[b]Settings[/b]
* Added sound settings (master volume, music, Keep's voice, effects).

notes.title: Beast Hour. №11. June 2022
notes.content:
Raiders & Beasts!

It’s been a crazy month for us all as Beast Hour Alpha-test has finally started! We as a team are so proud to have such a dedicated and overall great community and we're happy you are with us on this journey:)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/9afc9b222280472f16d19d43f6c9cdb5fc3d42c0.jpg[/img]

[b]Alpha-tests[/b]

Important date in Beast Hour history: 19th of June, 2022. This day we had our first public test and it lasted for three hours straight. Our goals for the test were:

1) Get your feedback on the gameplay (btw, you can leave it [url=https://forms.gle/krY6uGMySHaiPbDM8]here[/url] – it’d help us tremendously)
2) Check out how the servers are working.

Right now we are preparing the next version of the game which can take some time as we do want to make the game better and not just release the same build. The exact date of the next test will be announced later – stay tuned and join our [url=http://discord.gg/5KFaakTP24]Discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/63a9b3c0a4167ca5f58b52c70280394b1eceb661.gif[/img]

[b]Things we’re working on[/b]

We decided to focus on a few main issues first:

1) Udoku felt underpowered compared to Zelus.
2) It was difficult to get connected to a match.
3) Raiders need more ways to escape Beasts.
4) Sound options should be added.

Closer to the start of the next test we’ll be able to tell you more about the upcoming changes in detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/66e749db9fbb08d30f04e7442d61481ecaa2e2ad.jpg[/img]

[b]Prepare for the next game![/b]

A few tips for your future playtests:

- When you play as Raider – run away from Beasts, but not in a straight line: use parkour to get higher and always change directions to keep some distance between you and Beast.
- Heal your Raider character by completing Arkana quests.
- When you play as Beast – capture Altars (=parts of the map) to use Howl and track down Raiders with ease.
- As a Beast your HP gets automatically restored by simply staying out of a fight for some time. Also destroying Arkana speeds up the regeneration and empowers your next attacks.
- You can read gameplay tips and descriptions of abilities pressing F1 and F2 during the match.

Most important – watch the full tutorial to learn many cool gameplay nuances! https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQmBZ0P_Og9seydf29g-bmjZRE7kolblv 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/112eb978b2f5ddef867327ddfa8a3760d5e638fa.gif[/img]

[b]Also[/b]

We stream Beast Hour and answer your questions every month – you can watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ELUD4v7_S0]latest video[/url] on our YouTube channel. Join our next stream in the middle of July!

Wishlist Beast Hour on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563250/Beast_Hour/]Steam[/url] and follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/BeastHour]social media[/url] as we post new content every day! Support us on [url=http://patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url] as it really helps our indie team!

Contact us via email if you want to participate in the development or would like to discuss other forms of cooperation – bizdev@beasthour.com 

The Beast will come!

notes.title: Beast Hour. №5. 2021 summary🐺
notes.content:
[h3]Raiders & Beasts, hear our call! [/h3]

2021 is coming to an end. Hope it was a good year for you – please, share your thoughts of 2021 as we are eager to learn how you’ve been doing!

Our turn comes first :)

[h3]ANNOUNCEMENT[/h3]

2021 was special as it’s the year we announced Beast Hour back on April, 23. 

Before the announcement a lot of work was done: Steam-page, accounts & content for social media channels, Beast Hour website and many more minor things.

​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/45250e3b94ce05f0562a6e00d0080fa3eb98a26c.jpg[/img]

But the most important and complicated task for us was the announce trailer. The team had never done anything like this before and put a lot of effort and time into it. Now we are truly proud of the result as this trailer represents the essence of Beast Hour gameplay and atmosphere.
[previewyoutube=9pZjtai76JA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]​MAP[/h3]

Just to give you an example of how far the game has come this year, let’s see how Beast Hour looked like at the beginning of 2021 and the very end of it:

[b]Burning district:[/b]

​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/7d1e8a4103dd3bb69b76e632bec72b8ef0370b67.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2da4a80d231ef2da3fbbf018f97bfe520df80eaf.jpg[/img]

[b]Factory district:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/64d6ea0056caa2cca72400a6a8ee16a15394bcab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/34f5d08a958e52008336e94b881d82e6e72b0156.jpg[/img]

[b]Temple:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/4277ddfe67c1f22c3cb82960662591525f592c77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/3dc274528d28433bf730e2efbde474ab15761d6a.jpg[/img]

We’ve basically reworked the whole map to be sure that Beast Hour looks and feels great to play. The streets of the haunted city ought to be immersive for every Raider and Beast. We keep on working on this part of the game so the next year will bring even more great progress!

[h3]UDOKU[/h3]

In terms of characters, we have made an entire new Raider – Udoku Hiro. She is a poison-throwing lady deadly for those who dare to recklessly approach her without giving it a proper thought.

Udoku concept art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/2410f3ae667b293350b4b8cf965834c3dd62db02.jpg[/img]
​​
The original idea was simple: the opposite gameplay of our first Raider – Zelus. Unlike him, she deals damage not via direct hits but through AoE DoT. Udoku uses double (and even triple!) jumps instead of blink, can blind enemies and leave a poisonous trail behind, which gives her a great advantage while running away from Beasts.

Udoku in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/cd3d3c770e6bb2a0a5211ad9b9c6a497d5628b2f.gif[/img]

[h3]WATCH AND READ[/h3]

2021 was also the year Beast Hour started participating in special gaming events. DreamHack Beyond became the first one. During the event we held a Q&A-stream which you can watch right now! 
*It was at 5 a.m. our time – that’s why the devs look so sleepy :)
[previewyoutube=7PC7th4bpd4;full][/previewyoutube]
For our Russian-speaking community there is an interview with the creative director of Beast Hour, Anton Morozov:
[previewyoutube=q-KSw5uH_4Y;full][/previewyoutube]
​If you know Spanish, here's the [url=https://www.diez.hn/diezgaming/beast-hour-bestias-noche-parkour-pvp-entrevista-desarrolladores-AKDZ1504664]interview[/url] for you as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/b4a6ec802ba706a3b941e2d56455312630283274.gif[/img]

[h3]ALPHA-TESTING[/h3]

Our team has almost doubled in size during 2021. That’s because we want to start Alpha-testing for you to enjoy Beast Hour as soon as possible. 2022 is going to be a huge one for Beast Hour!

[url=https://mailchi.mp/11aebf4bafa7/join-beast-hour-eng]Sign up for the Alpha-testing[/url] coming in 2022!

Support us on [url=http://patreon.com/beasthour]Patreon[/url] to participate in closed playtests with devs, put your name in the credits, have a personal talk with us and many more!

Or just follow us on social media channels, wishlist the game and spread the word about Beast Hour. Every player matters!

If you want to help us with advice & feedback, just drop an e-mail at [url=mailto:bizdev@beasthour.com]bizdev@beasthour.com[/url]!

Thank you for being with us on this journey!

The Beast will come!

[h3]P. S.[/h3]
Any ideas who that might be?..
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40378796/a1e40dfffee2025909acf93fa373c8cc1592f012.jpg[/img]
